comment: Video 4 v3 — confident Matilda narration over upbeat music. Grounded in the Meridian deck. Open and close use the SAME tagline: 'the intelligence layer of Minor Hotels'.

lines.text: This is Meridian — the intelligence layer of Minor Hotels.
The strategy is set: from five hundred and ninety hotels today, toward one thousand by twenty twenty-nine. The technology has to match.
Great hotels run on great people. But their work is scattered across more than a dozen disconnected systems.
So we built one surface — a single, intelligent layer over everything Minor already runs.
One login. Every system underneath. A home for conversational, agentic AI.
For a general manager, it's the whole property in one view — revenue, arrivals, and every operation, live.
Ask once, and it acts — opening the work order, dispatching the team, and reassuring the guest, across three systems at once.
For every staff member, the right answer arrives the moment they ask — brand standards and know-how, in plain language.
It works in every hand, from the front desk to the housekeeping cart.
Guests are recognized the moment they arrive.
And to the guest, it simply feels like one, seamless Minor.
For owners, clarity — consolidated reporting, trust accounting, and disbursements, in real time.
Every Minor Discovery member is recognized, with guest intelligence no third party will ever have.
It scales to any model — owned, managed, franchise, or affiliate — live in days, on the systems partners already run.
Nothing is ripped out. Meridian is simply the layer above.
Whoever you are — manager, staff, owner, or guest — there's a surface built for you.
One platform. Six service domains. Every role, every property — integrated.
Meridian. The intelligence layer of Minor Hotels.
